common.skip_confirm_body: You can finish setup later from the menu bar icon.

welcome.title: Speak. Anywhere. Privately.
welcome.subtitle: Dictate into any app on your Mac. Everything runs on-device — no servers, no accounts.

accessibility.title: Grant Accessibility
accessibility.body: lda listens for your hotkey and types into the focused app. macOS requires Accessibility permission for both.

microphone.title: Microphone access
microphone.body: lda needs microphone access to capture your dictation. Audio is processed on-device and discarded after each transcription.
microphone.denied_hint: Microphone access is currently blocked. Open System Settings, allow Lirevo, then come back.
microphone.idle_hint: Click Test microphone, then say something.
microphone.hint_try_other: Not getting any sound. If your device is wireless (e.g. AirPods), it may not have switched to mic mode yet — try selecting a different input below.
microphone.hint_speak_louder: Picking up faint audio. Try speaking louder, or switch to a closer microphone.
microphone.tested_no_audio_hint: Try a different input device, or check your system volume.
microphone.tested_no_capture: Microphone did not produce any audio
microphone.tested_no_capture_hint: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and make sure Lirevo is allowed, then try again.
microphone.tested_device_silent: Device opened, but is producing silence
microphone.tested_device_silent_hint: '{{device}}' may be muted, paused, or (if Bluetooth) stuck in output-only mode. Try selecting a different input below.
microphone.tested_tcc_blocked_hint: macOS didn't show the permission prompt. Open System Settings, allow Lirevo (or your terminal app, if running from cargo), then click Test microphone again.

models.title: Choose your transcription model
models.body: Pick the speech-to-text model that fits the languages you dictate in. You can change it any time from Settings.

language.title: Pick your dictation language
language.body: We'll set up the right on-device model for the language you dictate in. You can change it any time from Settings.
language.reset_notice: Language reset because the new model doesn't support it.

downloads.title: Downloading your models
downloads.body: We're fetching the on-device models for dictation and cleanup. This runs once — they're cached for next time.

permissions.title: Grant permissions
permissions.body: Lirevo needs two macOS permissions: the microphone to hear you, and Accessibility to type into the focused app.
permissions.microphone_helper: Captures your dictation on-device; audio is discarded after each transcription.
permissions.accessibility_helper: Listens for your hotkey and types the result into the focused app.

general.title: Finish setup
general.body: Pick your push-to-talk key and decide how Lirevo lives on your Mac.
general.smart_mic_routing_helper: When audio is playing through Bluetooth headphones (e.g. AirPods), dictate with the built-in mic instead, so playback isn't downgraded to mono.

cleanup.title: Cleanup model (optional)
cleanup.body: Cleanup adds punctuation, capitalization, and tidies sentence flow. Dictation works without it — you can always add or change a cleanup model later from Settings.
cleanup.skip_body: No model loaded. Lirevo injects the raw transcript directly into the focused app.

background.title: How should it run?
background.body: lda is built to live in the menu bar — these settings decide how present it should be.
background.launch_at_login_helper: Start lda automatically when you sign in to your Mac. The hotkey is live as soon as the app is up.

hotkey.title: Choose your hotkey
hotkey.body: Hold this key while speaking. Release to dictate into the focused app.

general.force_pasteboard_helper: Skip Accessibility text injection; paste via clipboard instead.
general.record_history_helper: Keep a local history of your dictations on this device.
general.smart_mic_routing_helper: When audio is playing through Bluetooth headphones (e.g. AirPods), dictate with the built-in mic instead, so playback isn't downgraded to mono.
general.energy_helper: Auto adapts to system load. Pinning a profile overrides it, except when low battery or thermal pressure forces Power Saver.

microphone.section_helper: Test your selected input device — useful when switching headsets or after macOS audio changes.
microphone.idle_hint: Click Test microphone, then say something.
microphone.hint_try_other: Not getting any sound. If your device is wireless (e.g. AirPods), it may not have switched to mic mode yet — try selecting a different input above.
microphone.hint_speak_louder: Picking up faint audio. Try speaking louder, or switch to a closer microphone.
microphone.tested_no_audio_hint: Try a different input device, or check your system volume.
microphone.tested_no_capture: Microphone did not produce any audio
microphone.tested_no_capture_hint: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone and make sure Lirevo is allowed, then try again.
microphone.tested_device_silent: Device opened, but is producing silence
microphone.tested_device_silent_hint: '{{device}}' may be muted, paused, or (if Bluetooth) stuck in output-only mode. Try selecting a different input above.
microphone.tested_tcc_blocked_hint: Open System Settings, allow Lirevo, then click Test microphone again.

models.stt_section_helper: Switching to another model triggers a hot-swap — dictation pauses for a moment while the new weights load.
models.delete_blocked_tooltip: Can't uninstall the model currently in use — switch to another first.
models.delete_confirm_body: Removes the file ({{size}}) from disk. You can re-download it any time. If this model is currently selected, the path will be cleared and dictation will fall back to whatever's left.

home.title: Hold to dictate
home.ready_hint: Press and hold the key, then speak. Release to type into the focused app.
home.setup_incomplete_body: Complete the setup wizard to start dictating.
home.models_not_loaded_body: Open Settings to pick or download Whisper + LLM models.
